name: liquid-whatsapp
description: Liquid WhatsApp desktop client for macOS Catalina and Intel Macs — v1.0.0 security hardening
author: Gerald(Mateo DEV)

scripts.check: node --check main.js && node --check preload.js && node --check backend/core.js && node --check backend/integrity.js && node --check backend/local-store.js && node --check renderer/js/store.js && node --check renderer/js/api.js && node --check renderer/js/ui.js && node --check renderer/js/app.js && node --check scripts/patch-voip-capture.js && node --check scripts/after-pack-fuses.js
scripts.build:catalina: npm run check && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --x64 --publish never
scripts.check:renderer: node --check renderer/js/store.js && node --check renderer/js/api.js && node --check renderer/js/ui.js && node --check renderer/js/app.js

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Liquid WhatsApp uses the microphone to record voice notes.
extendInfo.NSCameraUsageDescription: Liquid WhatsApp uses the camera for supported calling features.
